entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The current major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: An open consortium creating advanced interoperability standards for 3D graphics, VR, and AR.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: A royalty-free specification for the efficient transmission and loading of 3D scenes and models.

entities.name: OpenUSD
entities.note: Universal Scene Description, an open and extensible ecosystem for describing 3D scenes.

entities.name: AOUSD
entities.note: The Alliance for OpenUSD, an organization standardizing the 3D ecosystem.

entities.name: OpenXR
entities.note: A royalty-free, open standard that provides high-performance access to AR and VR platforms.

entities.name: WebXR
entities.note: A web API for accessing virtual reality and augmented reality devices.

entities.name: W3C
entities.note: The World Wide Web Consortium, the main international standards organization for the World Wide Web.

entities.name: WebGPU
entities.note: A modern web API providing advanced graphics and computation capabilities.

entities.name: 3D Tiles
entities.note: An OGC standard for sharing, visualizing, fusing, and interacting with massive heterogeneous 3D geospatial content.

entities.name: OGC
entities.note: The Open Geospatial Consortium, an international standards organization for geospatial information.

entities.name: IFC
entities.note: Industry Foundation Classes, an open standard for building information modeling (BIM) data.

entities.name: buildingSMART
entities.note: The worldwide industry body driving the digital transformation of the built asset environment.

entities.name: three.js
entities.note: A popular cross-browser JavaScript library and API used to create and display animated 3D computer graphics in a web browser.

entities.name: Babylon.js
entities.note: A real-time 3D engine using a JavaScript library for displaying 3D graphics in a web browser via HTML5.

entities.name: A-Frame
entities.note: An open-source web framework for building virtual reality experiences.

entities.name: Cesium
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript library for world-class 3D globes and maps.

entities.name: PlayCanvas
entities.note: An open-source 3D game engine and interactive 3D application engine.

entities.name: Unreal Engine
entities.note: A 3D computer graphics game engine developed by Epic Games.

entities.name: Unity
entities.note: A cross-platform game engine developed by Unity Technologies.

entities.name: Blender
entities.note: A free and open-source 3D computer graphics software toolset.

entities.name: NVIDIA Omniverse
entities.note: A computing platform that enables individuals and teams to develop Universal Scene Description (OpenUSD) based 3D workflows.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source framework and runtime for 3D graphics on the Web, integrating X3D into HTML5.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: An open-source WebGL-based X3D and VRML player for the web.

entities.name: Inline
entities.note: An X3D node that can load external scenes, including glTF in X3D 4.0.

entities.name: CADGeometry
entities.note: An X3D component designed to support Computer-Aided Design structures.

entities.name: Geospatial
entities.note: An X3D component that enables the representation of geospatial data.

entities.name: Blender X3D Exporter
entities.note: An add-on for Blender that allows exporting scenes to the X3D format.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: An open-source cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D and glTF.

entities.name: WebGL
entities.note: A JavaScript API for rendering interactive 2D and 3D graphics within any compatible web browser.

entities.name: X3D Architecture
entities.note: The core specification document defining the structure and nodes of X3D.

entities.name: WebVR
entities.note: A deprecated experimental JavaScript API that provided support for virtual reality devices.

entities.name: X3D 3.3
entities.note: The previous major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard.

entities.name: WebAudio
entities.note: A high-level JavaScript API for processing and synthesizing audio in web applications.
